section_offset.description: Source rows to skip independently of identity candidate paging.

Reply_VariantGwas.description: One page of exact rsID catalog associations.

associations.description: Native source associations, without inferred clinical meaning.

continuation.description: Continue this section using the same rsID and source selectors.

page.description: Exact source page bounds and total.

Reply_VariantHeader.description: Consumer identity header with an exact source selection and compact annotation entity.

component_terms.description: Terms for carried component identifiers on this consumer header.

myvariant.description: Compact MyVariant annotations, attributed by their field name.

record.description: Exact source record, including source keys that are expressions rather than identifiers.

requested.description: Checked caller ID used by a source-only section, without asserting resolved identity.

sections.description: Explicitly requested source sections for this exact candidate.

transcripts.description: Source-paired transcript identifiers and unchanged coding and protein notation.

Reply_VariantHotspots.description: Source residue recurrence counts without allele-frequency or clinical interpretation.

next.description: Continue this section without changing identity selectors.

reason.description: Source rows remain candidates when no transcript/consequence join exists.

records.description: Native residue records in source order.

Reply_VariantId.description: Published variant-level identifiers, with each identifier's level retained.

Reply_VariantLookupInput.description: Accepted forms: rsID, CAid, clinvar:N, VCV accession, reference-qualified HGVS, chromosome genomic HGVS, or VCF-style chromosome-position-reference-alternate coordinates (SNVs, deletions, insertions and delins), defaulting to GRCh38. Reference bases are validated by the source.

Reply_VariantOncokb.description: Keyed OncoKB annotation, preserving the caller's assembly and tumor context.

alteration.description: Source-resolved protein alteration, independent of the requested genomic identity.

build.description: Explicit caller assembly, checked against the response query.

hgvsg.description: Exact genomic query sent to OncoKB.

hotspot.description: Source hotspot flag, without an actionability conclusion.

hugo_symbol.description: Source-resolved gene, without a genomic or protein conversion.

last_update.description: Native release date, kept in its published spelling.

next.description: Continue without changing identity, build, tumor context or source.

page.description: Disclosure bounds over the records, independent of identity paging.

records.description: Source claims and text in native field order.

tumor_type.description: Explicit caller tumor type, checked against the response query.

variant_exist.description: Native exact variant curation flag; never a clinical conclusion.

vus.description: Source investigated-but-unknown flag, never used to create a classification.

Reply_VariantPopulation.description: Bounded population summary with independent optional sequencing datasets.

dataset_version.description: Release shared by independently checked exome and genome totals in this response.

exome.description: Exome observation; omitted when the source dataset is null.

genome.description: Genome observation; omitted when the source dataset is null.

joint.description: Independent source joint totals, or an explicit empty state when none were supplied.

Reply_VariantPopulationQueryEcho.description: Reply selectors with the resolver that actually answered, omitted when no named resolver answered.

build.description: Explicit source assembly when required by identity input.

detail.description: Read source ancestry groups, preserving overlapping groups individually.

input.description: Exact published allele identity; ambiguous candidates must first be selected.

Reply_VariantPopulationResult.description: Population summary and one explicitly requested ancestry-detail page.

candidates.description: Source allele candidates when this input does not identify one joinable allele.

groups.description: Selected native groups, qualified by sequencing subset.

population.description: Source population state; missing datasets stay absent within its summary.

Reply_VariantPredictors.description: Source prediction scores and the terms of their individual components.

context.description: Original context arrays, without inferred cross-field alignment.

scores.description: Every retained source score in declared field order.

subject_qualification.description: How the source chromosome label was reference-qualified.

Reply_VariantRef.description: Checked source subject reference; at least one source identity or label is required.

oneOf.description: Exact allele identifier or reference-qualified notation.
Protein-level assertion, without genomic conversion.
Native ClinVar haplotype and its complete source member identities.

members.description: Complete member identities in native order.

oneOf.description: Native source variant with optional source-stated forms.
Compound source profile, without inferred allele identity or phase.

expression.description: Exact source expression and checked member relations.

members.description: Source member references in their native order.

Reply_VariantResolver.description: Explicit source service for reference-qualified notation.

Reply_VariantSection.description: Named variant source sections, without automatic expansion of identity cards.

Reply_VariantSections.description: Source-specific sections, absent unless explicitly selected.

alphagenome.description: Explicit keyed AlphaGenome numeric scorer result.

Reply_VariantTranscript.description: A source-paired transcript annotation, without inferred transcript equivalence.

component.description: Native component and field carrying the paired annotation.

hgvs_c.description: Source transcript notation from the coding field, including native n. or r. forms.

hgvs_p.description: Source protein notation, never translated from coding notation.

matched.description: Whether this row's source notation matched the declared caller notation.

transcript.description: Transcript identifier exactly as published, including its source version.

Reply_VcvId.description: A ClinVar variation accession, possibly a haplotype or compound.
